earnings.title: CENCORA REPORTS FISCAL 2026 FOURTH QUARTER AND FISCAL YEAR END RESULTS
highlights: Fourth Quarter Revenue of $88.4 Billion up 5.5 Percent.
GAAP Diluted EPS of $2.71 and Adjusted Diluted EPS of $4.66
Fiscal Year 2026 Revenue of $337.4 Billion up 5.0 Percent.
GAAP Diluted EPS of $17.95 and Adjusted Diluted EPS of $17.97
(NYSE: COR) today reported that in its fiscal year 2026 fourth quarter ended September 30, 2026, revenue increased 5.5 percent to $88.4 billion.

quotes.text: Fiscal 2026 was a pivotal year for Cencora, as we expanded our MSO platform through the acquisition of OneOncology, sharpened the focus of our portfolio and delivered record results.

outlook: Fiscal 2027 Adjusted Diluted EPS Expected to be in the Range of $19.40 to $19.75, reflecting growth of 8 percent to 10 percent

items.heading: Our revenue, financial position, results of operations, and cash flows may suffer upon the loss, or renewal at less favorable terms, of a key customer or group purchasing organization.
The anticipated ongoing benefits of our relationship with Walgreens and Boots may not be realized.
A disruption in our distribution or generic purchasing services arrangements with Walgreens or WBAD could adversely affect our business and financial results.
Our results of operations and financial position may be adversely affected if we acquire or invest in businesses that do not perform as we expect or that are difficult for us to integrate.
Our business and results of operations may be adversely affected if we fail to manage and complete divestitures.
We face geopolitical and other risks associated with our international operations, which could materially adversely impact our financial position, results of operations, and cash flows.
